(3) "repulsive" falls into the opinion category. (4) "exercise" falls into the purpose category. (5) "green" falls into the color category. (6) "Pakistani" falls into the origin category. (7) "computer" falls into the noun category. The adjective order that Option (A) has is [7. material] [2. age] [1. opinion] [8. purpose] [5. color] [6. origin] (or, in numeric terms, 7 2 1 8 5 6). Because 7 < 2 < 1 < 8 < 5 < 6 is not correct, (A) does not have the correct ordering.
Option (B): "repulsive new green Pakistani silver exercise computer". Option (B) has the following adjective order: [1. opinion] [2. age] [5. color] [6. origin] [7. material] [8. purpose] (or, in numeric terms, 1 2 5 6 7 8). Because 1 < 2 < 5 < 6 < 7 < 8 is correct, (B) has the correct ordering. So the answer is (B).
